name: Tree Of Life
overview: The Tree of Life, first introduced in Genesis as being in the midst of the Garden of Eden, symbolizes eternal life and God's provision for man. After Adam's fall, God prevented access to the Tree of Life to keep man from living forever in a fallen state, highlighting the seriousness of sin and its consequences. Proverbs uses the imagery of a tree of life to describe wisdom and fulfilled desire, portraying them as sources of true life and blessing for those who embrace them.
